entries.detail: Bash has no custom domain list; Go aggregates them into one rule
Bash has no custom IP list; Go aggregates them into one rule
Go apply sets IPIfNonMatch and sniffing routeOnly; not part of tb_build_block_rules
Go records owned_rules/previous_*; Bash keeps unknown keys
PublicPort=0 probes 127.0.0.1:443; a non-443 mode-none install fails apply
pinned geosite only carries cn; ru/ir/kp/gb/au/tr are rejected by xray -test
only the pure rule builder ran; menus, downloader and tb_apply_rules were not compared
xray uninstall --purge keeps traffic_blocker.json and block backups
probe is a local TCP connect; blocked requests were not replayed
with nothing applied Go exits 1 ('no traffic-block rules are installed') and keeps the config; Bash has no equivalent command

notes: The fixture runs `systemctl reset-failed xray` before scenarios that restart the unit: in this disposable container the default StartLimitBurst=5/10s rejects the sixth restart with start-limit-hit, which is a systemd rate limit rather than a traffic-block behaviour.
Each scenario is an independent operator action in production, so the rate-limit counter is cleared instead of stretching the fixture past the gate budget.
